Polygon data: mask of world oceans

Source: R/IsoriX-datasets.R
OceanMask.Rd

This dataset contains a polygon SpatVector (from terra). It can be used to mask large bodies of water. It is the complement of the polygons stored in CountryBorders within their extent.

Format

A SpatVector object

Source

See example for details on how we created the dataset.

See also

  • CountryBorders for another polygon used to embellish the plots

Examples


plot(OceanMask, col = "blue")
